parts_only_archive_publication.meaning: G1 original tar and four original A06 ZIPs are restored byte-for-byte from the selected parts. Original producer manifests remain unchanged. Local physical reappearance of an excluded original copy does not alter the explicit Git index/tree selection.

self_reference_rule.meaning: The manifest cannot hash itself; the final review hashes this manifest. Both terminal files are bound by the eventual Git commit. All other delivered results and the two edited documents are included.

remote_publication_scope: Remote source/head, CI and merge observations are retained in separate evidence and described with their own timestamps. This manifest does not infer merge or runtime qualification from publication.
